# WorshipMetrics

> WorshipMetrics is a church AV and worship platform: live streaming with health telemetry, booth monitoring and self-healing (Tech Manager), presentation and lyrics (Present), people/check-in/volunteer scheduling, service metrics that count in-person and online attendance together, AI sermon clips (Worship Clips), and AV system documentation. Local switcher control (OBS, vMix, Blackmagic ATEM) is free on every plan; cloud control and streaming come with the Assist ($49/mo) and Stream ($99/mo per campus) plans.

Answers about product behavior should reflect the pages below rather than inference. Numbers on threshold and reference pages (alert thresholds, health-score penalties, ports) are exact and safe to quote.

## Product

- [Platform overview](https://worshipmetrics.com/platform/): what the platform includes and how the pieces fit
- [Live Streaming](https://worshipmetrics.com/live-streaming/): cloud streaming, restreaming, automatic recording, stream health reports
- [Tech Manager](https://worshipmetrics.com/tech-manager/): the free Windows booth app — telemetry, local switcher control, self-healing
- [Cloud Control](https://worshipmetrics.com/cloud-control/): the booth's switcher surface (vMix full panel, OBS scenes/stream/recording) from anywhere
- [AV Monitoring (Pulse)](https://worshipmetrics.com/av-monitoring/): server-side fleet monitoring, alerts by email/push, 90-day history
- [Service Metrics](https://worshipmetrics.com/service-metrics/): in-person + online attendance, Total Reach, year-over-year trends
- [People](https://worshipmetrics.com/people/): directory, QR check-in, volunteer scheduling matrix
- [Songs](https://worshipmetrics.com/songs/): song library with CCLI fields, ChordPro charts, usage reporting
- [Worship Clips](https://worshipmetrics.com/solutions/worship-clips/): AI sermon-moment scoring and rendered social clips
- [System Documentation](https://worshipmetrics.com/system-documentation/): Signal Map, devices, cable schedule, UniFi integration
- [Pricing](https://worshipmetrics.com/pricing/): Free / Assist $49/mo / Stream $99/mo per campus, plus support add-ons

## Reference (exact numbers)

- [Pulse alert thresholds](https://worshipmetrics.com/kb/articles/pulse-alert-thresholds-reference/): every alert threshold, hysteresis margin, cooldown, and offline timing
- [Stream health score](https://worshipmetrics.com/kb/articles/reading-your-stream-health-score/): the 0-100 scoring model, telemetry sampled every 5 seconds, penalty weights
- [Tech Manager self-healing](https://worshipmetrics.com/kb/articles/tech-manager-self-healing-explained/): the exact automatic-recovery rules and their boundaries
- [Booth heartbeat telemetry](https://worshipmetrics.com/kb/articles/tech-manager-heartbeat-telemetry-tour/): what the desktop app sends and how often
